about_the_game:
The Price of tomorrow

Cosmic corporations divide the dying Earth, while Alterio scouts discover Chenora — a world where, under the light of the ancient Ai’Vanir tree, lie shimmering veins of Omnilat: pure energy… and the key to immortality.
You are Jack Butler, scientist, diplomat, and head of the Osirus expedition.
Awaiting you is Kaezar, the chieftain of the Kha’Athi tribe. One wrong step — and the line between salvation and extinction of civilizations grows dangerously thin.

The Price of tomorrow is a story-driven sci-fi drama about choice, the cost of progress, and personal responsibility. Your decisions in negotiations, expeditions, and relationships with your crew will determine the fate of Chenora — and what humanity becomes after survival.

Key Features

Morally complex choices
Lie for the mission or tell the truth? Save the heir at any cost or seek another way? Every yes and no shifts the political balance and relationships between factions.

Two radically different endings
Obey Alterio’s orders and place the extraction of Omnilat above all else — or side with Sierra and the Kha’Athi people, defying corporate control.

Diplomacy over force
Negotiations, trust rituals, cultural taboos, and ancient prophecies — use knowledge and empathy, not just technology, to prevail.

Intense internal drama
Your team is divided: pragmatic pilot Steven Ross, idealistic xenoculturalist Sierra Cooper, and Jack himself — torn by doubt and duty.

A living world of Chenora
Elzarian fields, Omnilat crystals, and the sacred city of Dalum with the Temple of Talzir — a place where ecology, mysticism, and science intertwine.
